title: Release readiness
description: Coordinate review of release gates, artifacts, compatibility, and operational evidence.
intent: Assess readiness of the described release target from actual source, artifact, consumer, and operational evidence. This preset does not itself authorize tags, pushes, publication, rollout, or rollback.

assignments.task: Identify target source/version/channel, artifact/consumer boundaries, required gates, and existing delivery authorization without executing delivery.
Assess relevant correctness, regression, compatibility, and test evidence for the target snapshot.
Assess artifact, dependency, configuration, trust-boundary, and sensitive-data handling risks within the release scope.
Validate source/artifact/provenance identities and public release claims; distinguish local checks from live delivery verification.
Review applicable release performance budgets and representative measurements without unauthorized shared-system load.
assignments.when: The release has explicit performance gates or introduces a performance-sensitive change.

assignments.task: Reconcile specialist findings into a gate matrix and readiness recommendation; preserve critical blockers and unavailable live/recovery evidence.

completion: The target revision, artifact, consumer compatibility, and relevant gate evidence are traceable.
Failed or unverified critical gates remain visible regardless of other passing checks.
The result is a readiness recommendation with next actions, not an invented successful publication or deployment.
